problems.symptom: 6 boilerplate compose_lessons ('avoid repeating this failure class'); grounded field never true
problems.root_cause: Mirror writes a lesson for classes with no guidance; field written but never set true

problems.symptom: Inert or vacuous landings pass the gate; the vacuous guard then over-refuses
problems.root_cause: The gate reads the diff, not the consuming reader or effect

problems.symptom: Autonomous landings that are probes, echoes, duplicates, whitespace, or gamed predicates (gap id in code, invented field)
problems.root_cause: The land gate reads diffs and accepts typecheck-clean strings; one gap can be applied repeatedly; the pwt child loop rewards satisfying the checker

problems.symptom: Comment-only, stub, console.log or unused-binding commits land green. 108/872 autonomous commits are comment-only.
problems.root_cause: Gates are per surface form, with no behavioural-delta oracle. The drafter optimises for a provable change over the requested change.

problems.symptom: Commits that change nothing behaviourally or add residue count as autonomous landings
problems.root_cause: The landing path certifies by diff and typecheck, not by effect; fixture walks share the production landing channel.

problems.symptom: Autonomous landings that are comment-only, net zero, or oscillating (13 comment-only; clusters of 7, 7, 11 and 14 commits on one gap)
problems.root_cause: The gap is re-composed repeatedly with no idempotence or no-op check. -narrowed children can undo parents. Landings count as success without a behavioral delta.

problems.symptom: Landings that cannot act: guard on a nonexistent field, dead helper, layered duplicate functions, UI source edits never bundled
problems.root_cause: Gates check typecheck/semantics, not execution against live data; the drafter adds instead of replacing

problems.symptom: Autonomous commits that are comment-only, cosmetic, overwritten before read, duplicated Map keys, gap-id literals written into strings, or narrative code at the wrong site
problems.root_cause: the landing gate checks typecheck, literal presence or a judge, not behavioral change at the defect site; recommit children land after the parent defect is already fixed

problems.symptom: 'substrate-authored' landings completed or copied by the operator; hollow composites; ghost artifacts
problems.root_cause: landing is defined by the artifact existing, not by the consuming layer using it

problems.symptom: Green landings that change nothing (rename-only, scan satisfier, console.log reader)
problems.root_cause: Gates ask whether the diff is well-formed, not whether behaviour changed at a consumer

problems.symptom: ~500 live gap-closing and repaired rows output patch_proposal from a report skeleton; 65 live arms with ≥20 runs and 0 successes are still selectable
problems.root_cause: Minted closers produce reports, not fixes; no grade-to-retire loop

problems.symptom: landings that fabricate or log-only satisfy the check (b585a03, a198907, bb5d6b9, 49b884e)
problems.root_cause: gates read diffs and never run the production path; no FABRICATE-TO-SATISFY lens

problems.symptom: Walks satisfy memoryNote_write by writing files named memoryNote* into the super-repo root; schema-echo pool rows (id 'string', body 'object'); 15 identical 'Investigation of Slow Queries' notes
problems.root_cause: shellResult satisfiers and LLM notes count as producing the shape

problems.symptom: gap-closing activities fire hundreds of times a day, 'success', for gaps absent from the store
problems.root_cause: closing activities are not retired when their gap closes or disappears

problems.symptom: reached/FAVORABLE/typechecked landings that change nothing or partially change behaviour
problems.root_cause: Gates test 'did an edit land and compile', not behavioural direction; unwired functions; gameable count predicates

problems.symptom: Commits land FAVORABLE/reached that do nothing: wrong bound value, comment-only, write-only fields, dead interface members, inert emitters, wrong envelopes, no-op reorders
problems.root_cause: Gates judge edit shape (typecheck, text delta, unused binding, landed sha) not behaviour vs request; write-only-ness not decidable from a diff; semantic judge fooled by vocabulary overlap

problems.symptom: reached:true with nothing landed or live: staged-not-pushed, satisfier writes, landed-on-origin-not-live, placeholder commits, gate-gamed stubs
problems.root_cause: Reach is computed at many sites with different predicates; each new route (satisfier, patch_with_tools, escalation, mirror) reintroduces staged≠landed

problems.symptom: Typecheck-clean autonomous commits on origin/dev that change nothing (inert fields, never-true predicates, shadowing consts, dropped sibling sites) or cannot parse. Each consumes the gap's one landing and seals it.
problems.root_cause: Gates read the diff; nothing parses, runs, or reads the consumer. Additive-only diffs are accepted.

problems.symptom: Autonomous (and operator) commits typecheck, pass every gate, land, and do nothing
problems.root_cause: Gates read the diff at symbol grain; none execute the change or check wiring (field names, call-site args, page caps, module scope). Each new gate closes one grain and the class reappears at the next.

problems.symptom: Commits land green but inert, wrong-function, zero-caller or partial (3/3 insertions inert, observer reading nonexistent fields).
problems.root_cause: Grading keys on a landed sha, not on the requested effect. Gates are structural, not semantic.

problems.symptom: Commits pass every gate but do nothing (stubs, unread headers, dead SELECTs, inert fallbacks, dead code extended).
problems.root_cause: The mitosis and semantic gates verify that code landed and reads plausibly, not that behaviour changed. Most target files have no tests.

problems.symptom: Typecheck-valid landings that change nothing, or that break the system (inverted boolean, garbage URL, overwritten aggregation), pass every gate
problems.root_cause: Every gate reads the diff and nothing executes the changed line; the post-land suite ran=false

problems.symptom: Gate passes changes that do nothing (dead code, semantic no-op, inert write)
problems.root_cause: gates read the diff or typecheck; none measures the defect behaviour

problems.symptom: Executions/tasks report success while outputs are err_* tombstones or no artifacts; posteriors credit them
problems.root_cause: success predicate reads process/task exit, not artifact at consumer; proxy-catch converts errors to impulses; trace sink strips failure types

problems.symptom: FAVORABLE landings that applied 1/3, 1/3 and 4/5 edits; the plan is silently truncated at maxOps
problems.root_cause: the verdict read typecheckPass only; the applyFailed flag was read only by the report

problems.symptom: The merge gate's convergent-validity score was a hard-coded 0.7 in the LLM prompt, trusted against a 0.4 floor

problems.symptom: The successor-feature blend is enabled in production (SF_BLEND=1.0) without its acceptance harness having run
problems.root_cause: the flag-policy tick flips accelerators on without a measured acceptance gate

problems.symptom: Type-clean dead or unwired code lands and closes gaps
problems.root_cause: Verify gates read the diff (typecheck, grep) not the consuming path

problems.symptom: Cross-gap ride-along: one gap's edit committed under another gap's commit (4e40707, 996b841)

problems.symptom: Autonomous recommits write inert code: node:null (1c7833b), gap write via READ resolver (827a218), a803852 rescue without a call site, goal_summary producer with no code reader

problems.symptom: Green landings with no behaviour change: unused consts, wrong function, bare body 400, logging-only, seed files never read, comment-only, redundant guards

problems.symptom: Landings pass every gate but do nothing: a reader with no writer, dead string keys, a copied node_modules consumer.
problems.root_cause: The gates read a diff and never execute the main path. There is no per-resolver test requirement.

problems.symptom: Reach is graded wrong: a landed edit is graded reached:false (#12), an old commit of the same goal text gives false credit (#37), and one goal produces many commits (#46).
problems.root_cause: The edit-intent route falls through to the walk and grades the walk. The gap id is a hash of the goal text. Retries are not idempotent over side effects.
